headline: 1-2-1 body transformation coaching in Haverfordwest
bio: Gareth coaches clients 1-2-1 at his private training facility on the Withybush estate in Haverfordwest, with a bespoke nutrition plan alongside training. He also runs small fitcamp classes of up to eight people and online fat loss and muscle gain coaching.
name: Gareth Bicknell

headline: Yoga and group fitness classes around St Davids
bio: Sophie teaches Vinyasa yoga in St Davids, yoga and mobility classes, and a 45-minute Sweat-45 group fitness class in Roch mixing circuits, kettlebells and HIIT. She offers 1-2-1 yoga, beach yoga in the summer months and remote coaching.
name: Sophie

headline: Small private gym in Haverfordwest for people who feel out of place in gyms
bio: Amy runs Tidal Fitness, a small private gym in Haverfordwest, with 1-2-1, pairs and small group personal training and supportive group classes Monday to Thursday. The focus is on confidence, simple workouts and nutrition guidance without fads.
name: Amy

headline: Personal training and yoga with a private studio in Pembrokeshire
bio: Casey offers personal training, yoga and wellness coaching in person in Pembrokeshire and online, with bespoke strength and wellness programmes and an eight-week programme built around your goals. Sessions take place in a private studio.
name: Casey Rogers

headline: Small group personal training for women in Armagh
bio: Tribe Fitness runs small group personal training in Armagh city centre for women aged 35 to 55 who want to get stronger and more confident. New members start with a 30-day foundation block of three coached sessions a week, simple nutrition support and a weekly check-in.
name: Tribe Fitness

headline: Small group Pilates classes in Portadown
bio: Leah teaches small group Pilates classes in Portadown focused on posture, core strength and mobility, in a friendly, community-focused setting. Classes run on Monday evenings and Tuesday mornings.
name: Leah

headline: Reformer and mat Pilates studio in Portadown
bio: Align is a reformer Pilates studio in Portadown running reformer and mat classes for everyone from complete beginners to regulars, with a friendly, community feel.
name: Align Reformer Pilates

headline: Reformer and mat Pilates with infrared sauna in Portadown
bio: Reform & Flow Pilates on Church Street in Portadown offers reformer and mat Pilates classes alongside infrared sauna sessions, in a supportive studio setting.
name: Reform & Flow Pilates

headline: Endurance, strength and rehab coaching for athletes in Ripon
bio: Raw Fitness Company coaches athletes from the Sports Pavilion in Ripon, with individual plans covering endurance training, strength and conditioning, injury prehab and rehab, and race nutrition. Coaching starts with a 90-minute consultation to build a performance profile.
name: Rich

headline: Reformer Pilates studio in Ripon
bio: Thrive is a reformer Pilates studio at Hutton Conyers on the edge of Ripon, running around 24 group classes a week, including foundation, flow and seniors classes, plus 1-2-1 and 2-2-1 private reformer sessions. Pre and postnatal classes are planned for 2026.
name: Mel

headline: Mat Pilates, yin yoga and 1-2-1 sessions in Ripon and Nidderdale
bio: Joanna founded Nidderdale Pilates and Fitness in 2015. She teaches technique-led mat Pilates and yin yoga classes in Ripon, Hampsthwaite and Glasshouses, and offers one-to-one sessions, adapting exercises for injuries and people returning after an operation.
name: Joanna Boyes

headline: Small studio Pilates near Middleham, plus online classes
bio: Posie teaches small in-studio Pilates classes near Middleham in the Yorkshire Dales for beginners through to advanced, and runs an online membership with on-demand classes and live Zoom sessions.
name: Posie

headline: Personal training in South Horrington or at your home near Wells
bio: Greg has spent seven years helping people make simple, sustainable changes, and is also a qualified wellness coach. He trains clients 1-2-1 or as couples at a gym in South Horrington, or at home within 10 miles of Wells, with resistance-based training for balance, mobility, strength and power.
name: Greg Roome

headline: One-to-one and small group strength training in Glastonbury and Wells
bio: Loxley offers one-to-one personal training and small group sessions in Glastonbury and Wells, focused on strength training, with a programme designed around your goals and nutrition support.
name: Loxley King

headline: Private personal training and wellbeing studio in Wells
bio: Lou and Paul run a fully private personal training and wellbeing studio in Wells, combining personal training with wellbeing coaching to help people build lasting habits, regain energy and get stronger and more mobile, without quick fixes or rigid diets.
name: Lou and Paul

headline: Personal training in Wells, at home or online
bio: Jess is a personal trainer in Wells offering personalised training in person, at your home or online, for people taking their first steps as well as those who want to push their fitness further.
name: Jess Baxter

headline: Personal training in Wells since 2011
bio: Focused Fitness has offered personal training in Wells since 2011, covering functional training and conditioning, weight loss, muscle gain and nutrition advice, plus group and circuit sessions.
name: Focused Fitness

headline: Personal training and mindset coaching in Rhyl
bio: Stephen qualified as a personal trainer in 2019 and ran his own studios for six years before moving his coaching to a gym in Rhyl. He offers tailored one-to-one packages with a workout booklet to track progress, combining training with mindset and lifestyle coaching.
name: Stephen Tomlinson

headline: Small group personal training in Rhyl for beginners
bio: 3Sixty runs small group personal training from a private coaching facility in Rhyl, aimed at adults who are nervous about starting or haven't trained for years, with a focus on beginners and injury rehab. Members also get an app to track workouts, nutrition and progress.
name: 3Sixty Personal Training

headline: One-to-one classical Pilates on the full apparatus in St Asaph
bio: FUNLAYO offers personalised classical Pilates in St Asaph using the full range of classical apparatus, not just reformer or mat, with one-to-one studio sessions and online sessions.
name: Funlayo Classical Pilates

headline: Group, private and online Pilates in Colwyn Bay
bio: Marta is a certified Pilates instructor running Pilates Flow in Mochdre, Colwyn Bay, with group classes, 1-to-1 and semi-private sessions, and online classes for different fitness levels.
name: Marta

headline: By-appointment-only private training studio in Swansea
bio: The Personal Training Studio in Swansea is closed to the public and works by appointment only, so every session is one-to-one with a dedicated trainer and no one else around. Programmes are built around your individual needs rather than a set routine.
name: The Personal Training Studio

headline: Female personal trainer with a private studio in Langland
bio: Dannii is a personal trainer and fitness instructor with a private personal training studio in Langland, Swansea, offering one-to-one personal training and fitness classes.
name: Dannii T

headline: One-to-one training at a private gym in Swansea for aches, pains and strength
bio: Back To Fitness offers one-to-one personal training at a private gym in Swansea, helping people build strength, reduce age-related aches and pains and stay consistent, in a calm and supportive setting.
name: Back To Fitness

headline: Pilates around Swansea and online since 2002
bio: Pili-Pala, founded in 2002 as Practical Pilates, is led by Emma and a team of Pilates instructors teaching clients around Swansea and South Wales, plus online classes.
name: Emma

headline: Fully private personal training in a Southsea studio
bio: Harley is a personal trainer, nutritionist and chef who coaches clients one-to-one at Workout Coach, a private boutique studio on Elm Grove in Southsea, combining training with nutrition support.
name: Harley Elliott

headline: Personal training and gym confidence coaching around Fareham
bio: TraintoAdapt offers personal training and gym confidence coaching for people who find starting at the gym daunting, with in-person sessions around Fareham, at-home sessions and online plans.
name: TraintoAdapt

headline: Group personal training in Havant
bio: My PT Hub runs group personal training from Haywards Business Centre in Havant, in a supportive and friendly setting aimed at building strength, energy and fewer aches and pains.
name: My PT Hub

headline: 1-2-1 personal training in Havant and Waterlooville, plus online coaching
bio: Josh offers 1-2-1 personal training at leisure centres in the Havant and Waterlooville area, with nutrition advice and online coaching, for goals including strength, weight loss and general fitness.
name: Josh Cantillon

headline: Personal training, sports conditioning and sports massage in Derby
bio: Movement Personal Training in Derby offers personal training, sports conditioning and sports massage therapy, with a background in coaching elite and professional athletes, including clients Luke has trained since 2013.
name: Luke

headline: One-to-one, partner and small group strength coaching in central Derby
bio: Derby Fitness Hub is based in a listed building in central Derby and offers one-to-one and partner personal training, small group strength and conditioning classes and remote coaching. Programmes are led by a UKSCA-accredited, MSc-qualified coach with over 20 years of experience.
qualifications: UKSCA accredited strength and conditioning coach
name: Pete

headline: Friendly mat Pilates classes in Darley Abbey, Allestree and Little Eaton
bio: Louise is a qualified Pilates teacher running friendly mat Pilates classes across Derby, including Darley Abbey, Allestree and Little Eaton, for complete beginners and more experienced students.
name: Louise Walker

headline: Private 1-to-1 and small group training studio in Keighley
bio: Power Haüs is a private personal training studio in Keighley, run by head coach and founder Ryan Suddards and formerly known as Sudzeh Fit. Sessions are 1-to-1 or in small groups, away from a busy public gym.
name: Ryan Suddards

headline: Personal training, sports massage and rehab in Shipley, with online coaching
bio: Align is a personal training and sports therapy practice based in Shipley, Bradford. It works with athletes and complete beginners alike, building strong foundations or rehabilitating an injury, with sports massage, in-person sessions and online coaching.
name: Align Training

headline: Small reformer Pilates studio in Bingley
bio: Maple is an independent reformer Pilates studio in Bingley, running small classes with a focus on strengthening the body, calming the mind and building a friendly, supportive community.
name: Maple Reformer Pilates
